risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/payment/** per risk-map B2-15g; no ledger entries, no balance read or write — BR-PAY-01 ③). payment module skeleton and pay-order use cases: biz-type registry (prod registers nothing; non-prod test_item 1 fen), PayChannel + FakePayChannel through the PayChannelSet token, create (switch / sellability 30901, per-object advisory lock, same-channel reissue, channel switch / stranger / closing / expired → 20902, PAID → 30902, Idempotency-Key, out_trade_no P+20 CSPRNG, channel failure 50306 keeps PENDING, launch never logged), detail (unsigned, D10-245), returned (order.query once), cancel (closing + order.close); pay queue registered exclusive (D-PAY-11: platform JobQueue refuses singletonKey on standard queues; frozen [AC-B2-15b#28/#30] need singleton_key); the four /v1/pay/orders operations leave planned (CT-21c) and the route request schemas are regenerated. Rule tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, claude-opus-5-5; Codex unavailable until 2026-10-30, approvals #36), 37 cases red on the AWS test machine; spec-test review by a fresh Claude subagent: pass (5 S2, recorded in PAY-lane/plan.md). Implementation by a Claude Fable 5.1 subagent (high reasoning, approvals #34). Money review by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh): round 1 pass (4 S2), round 2 fail (1 S1: expiry condition landed in markClosing — fixed in 4becd7dd), round 3 see reviews[]. Two frozen tests tightened (pay-http http.test.ts planned → implemented; queue contract.test.ts pay pinned) and the rule-test kit restructured for depcruise (run-time import of @couli/db/testing), each by a fresh Claude subagent, structure / tightening only (D10-206 / D10-282 precedents). Orchestrated by pay-acct4 (Claude Fable 5.1). Ledger PR #1187, paths #1440.
